# view_component

**Tag**: web, testing, template, tooling

## 简介

A framework for building reusable, testable & encapsulated view components in Ruby on Rails.

## 官网

- 主页: https://viewcomponent.org
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/viewcomponent/view_component
- 更新日志: https://github.com/ViewComponent/view_component/blob/main/docs/CHANGELOG.md
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/view_component
